project_type: Django 4.2 LTS monolithic web application with vanilla JS frontend
language: Python 3.12, Django templates, vanilla JavaScript ES6+, CSS3
build_system: Django staticfiles with WhiteNoise, no build pipeline currently
test_framework: Django test suite (55 tests in core/tests/)
verification_instructions: 1. Run collectstatic to generate compressed assets. 2. Start dev server with 'python manage.py runserver'. 3. Test key pages (/, /projects/, /workshop/) in browser. 4. Run Lighthouse audit on deployed Railway URL to verify performance improvements.
snapshot_or_generated_files: staticfiles/ directory generated by collectstatic, contains .gz compressed versions via WhiteNoise CompressedStaticFilesStorage. Command: python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
environment_constraints: Production uses Railway with PostgreSQL. WhiteNoise already configured for static file serving with compression. DEBUG=False in production enables aggressive caching (WHITENOISE_MAX_AGE=31536000). Local dev uses SQLite.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or AGENTS.md found. Follow Django best practices. Maintain existing security headers middleware. Preserve all existing functionality.
key_patterns: 1. Base template at templates/core/base.html loads global CSS/JS. 2. Per-page CSS via {% block extra_css %} pattern. 3. All JS already uses defer attribute (good). 4. CSS versioning via ?v=N query strings. 5. Media=print onload trick already used for some non-critical CSS (live-chat.css, idea-modal.css). 6. Bootstrap 5.3.3 loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net. 7. Google Fonts preloaded with crossorigin. 8. Some templates have inline <style> blocks.
directory_structure: projectshub/ (Django config), core/ (main app with views/models/admin), templates/core/ (26 HTML templates), static/css/ (33 CSS files totaling ~1.1MB), static/js/ (16 JS files), staticfiles/ (collectstatic output with .gz files), media/ (uploads)
